findings.expected: D1-MR08: valid methods earn their mapped criteria.
findings.actual: R1 is defined only as solving v=0 then comparing roots/testing signs about them. In every no-change tuple a complete argument exists without solving: both endpoint values have the same sign and the parabola's concavity (k<0: v(0),v(T)>0; k>0: v(0),v(T)<0, convex) keeps v of one sign, or the completed square gives the minimum. Such a fully justified, correct solution gets no R1, so no R3/R4: 1/4.

findings.repair: Add an R1 alternative: a valid complete argument that v keeps one sign on [0,T] (endpoint signs with concavity, or vertex/minimum value), or v=0 solved with comparison; same award, not additive.
